title: The Old Blood
globalRules: Never reveal Victor as the initial killer without player-earned evidence.
Edric remains dormant until the Sealed Crypt is breached.
If Victor is stopped before entering the Sealed Crypt, Edric remains dormant.
The Flooded Shrine is the deeper causal threat and is not automatically discovered by solving Victor's murders.
Killing Edric does not restore Brannam.
Destroying the Flooded Shrine ends its local influence but does not restore Brannam's material prosperity.
The Sacrificial Blood Rite can restore prosperity only at the recurring cost stated by the source.
Every night of meaningful delay while a valid murderer remains active can trigger the source murder procedure and advance collapse.
Rumours are statements by characters, not campaign truth flags.
Free-text actions are valid and must be adjudicated against current facts and state rather than forced into a listed choice.

clocks.name: Brannam Collapse
clocks.advanceRule: Advance according to murder totals and source decay events. Do not advance solely because a scene occurred.
effects: 2: fear and curfew; families start leaving
5: severe decay events and institutional withdrawal
6: effective collapse of remaining civic order

clocks.name: Edric's Return
clocks.advanceRule: Only advances after Edric awakens and successfully feeds.
effects: 1: Belltower rings at midnight without cause
2: dogs howl and whimper at night
3: abnormal cold and candle behaviour at Saint Arlen's Chapel
4: old Brannam images weep dark oily blood
5: residents wake drained with missing memories
6: ravens gather in abnormal numbers; Edric nears/full restoration

scenes.title: A City Waiting to Die
requiredFacts: Brannam is a decaying former trade city.
Two recent bodies, Marya Dolen and Harrin Velth, were found drained of blood with puncture-like wounds.
Residents are reviving stories about Edric von Braech.
hiddenFacts: Victor Marlowe killed both victims.
Edric is dormant.
The Flooded Shrine is influencing Victor.

choices.label: Ask residents what happened
Go to the Graveyard
Find the mayor or guards
Find someone who knows Brannam's history

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Allow any plausible movement/investigation. Do not expose hidden killer or shrine without earned evidence.

scenes.title: Rumours, Fear and Bad Explanations
requiredFacts: Brannam contains contradictory rumours about Edric, the Chapel, the Ruins and recent disappearances.
hiddenFacts: Some rumours are false or partially true by design.

choices.label: Consult the local alchemist
Speak with Father Brenwick
Question Crowmarket and tradespeople
Trace where the victims were last seen
Investigate the sewers early

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Route investigation to the location/NPC actually implicated by the player's method. Reward sensible lateral investigation without turning one clue into automatic solution.

scenes.title: What Passes for Government
requiredFacts: Mayor Elana Fost and Captain Ren Halvard are trying to preserve order with limited resources.
Guard activity responds to panic rather than secret truth.

choices.label: Ask about the victims and discovery of their bodies
Ask what authorities know about Edric
Offer to investigate officially
Leave the authorities and pursue another lead

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Authorities can share public/civic facts but cannot reveal Victor or the Shrine without evidence.

scenes.title: Songs About a Dead City
requiredFacts: Feyra Lrowyn knows Brannam's regional history.
hiddenFacts: If asked about the King Below or connected old lore, Feyra can associate it with a tale of a Flooded Shrine.

choices.label: Ask about Edric's conquest and fall
Ask about the King Below
Ask what survived from Edric's keep
Return to the murder investigation

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Feyra can provide regional history. Do not let an unprompted conversation reveal a secret phrase the PCs have never encountered.

scenes.title: Three Recent Graves
requiredFacts: The newest graves include Marya Dolen and Harrin Velth; Evelyn Marlowe was buried about a month earlier.
hiddenFacts: Evelyn's grave is empty.

choices.label: Inspect the victims' graves and burial information
Investigate Evelyn Marlowe's grave
Watch the Graveyard after dark
Ask who handled Evelyn's funeral

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Physical investigation may reveal the empty grave if the players actually inspect/exhume/test it. Do not reveal Evelyn's current location until evidence leads to the lab.

scenes.title: The Dead Do Not Rest Quietly
requiredFacts: The Graveyard is significantly more dangerous at night and can produce skeleton encounters.

choices.label: Stand your ground
Withdraw before being surrounded
Study the undead rather than chase the murder theory

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve with native rules. Presence of skeletons does not prove Edric committed the murders.

scenes.title: Saint Arlen's Chapel
requiredFacts: Father Brenwick officiated Evelyn's funeral.
The Chapel provides access to Catacombs but Brenwick considers lower areas unsafe.
hiddenFacts: Clergy tradition preserves stories of blood worship predating Edric.

choices.label: Ask about Evelyn Marlowe's funeral
Ask about old religious stories and Edric
Ask to enter the Catacombs
Speak with the Chapel caretaker
Return to the investigation

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Brenwick resists unsafe access but can be persuaded or bypassed based on current threat/evidence. Do not make him the killer or a secret mastermind.

scenes.title: Warnings from Before Edric
requiredFacts: Material recovered from the Ruins can contain warnings/references to the King Below.
hiddenFacts: This clue points toward an older cause beneath the vampire story.

choices.label: Study the old warning material
Take the name to Feyra Lrowyn
Trace the relic back to Edric's Ruins

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Reward historical comparison. Do not jump straight from the name King Below to the exact location/function of the Flooded Shrine unless additional source clues justify it.

scenes.title: Victor Marlowe's Apothecary
requiredFacts: Victor presents as a helpful local alchemist.
His work area is obsessively clean and an expected distillation coil is missing.
hiddenFacts: Victor moved the coil to his Secret Laboratory.
A concealed sewer hatch is present.

choices.label: Ask Victor about the blood-drained victims
Observe his laboratory equipment
Look for hidden access or signs of movement
Leave and discreetly follow Victor later
Confront Victor with the evidence you have

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Victor's reaction scales with how much real evidence PCs show. Casual suspicion does not force confession or escape. Strong proof can trigger flight.

scenes.title: What Victor Has Been Buying
requiredFacts: Multiple ordinary tradespeople have pieces of Victor's recent procurement history.

choices.label: Ask the glassworker about Victor's equipment
Ask the butcher about Victor's blood purchases
Ask about unusual cloth orders
Trace Victor's unusual ritual dagger
Compare these purchases with Victor's claimed normal work

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Each merchant provides only their own transaction knowledge. Accumulated pattern can justify increased suspicion and searching for a second laboratory.

scenes.title: Where the Blood Was Taken
requiredFacts: Victor used a derelict Northgate residence after ambushing Marya and Harrin near Crowmarket.
hiddenFacts: The crime scene can contain evidence of alchemical restraint/blood extraction rather than a feeding vampire.

choices.label: Search the derelict residence carefully
Trace movement back toward Crowmarket
Check drains/sewer access nearby
Leave before the abandoned district becomes more dangerous

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Evidence should indicate method, not magically identify Victor unless combined with other clues.

scenes.title: The Empty Annex
requiredFacts: The Annex is largely abandoned and contains Victor's hidden laboratory.
hiddenFacts: Victor's Secret Laboratory contains Evelyn's body, moved equipment and Voice-from-Below notes.

choices.label: Use the derelict watchtower to look for signs of movement
Search abandoned buildings for Victor's second workspace
Approach from the sewer network
Return to safer streets

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Finding the lab requires plausible searching/surveillance, not mere arrival in the Annex.

scenes.title: What Victor Was Trying to Undo
requiredFacts: Evelyn's exhumed corpse is here.
Moved alchemical equipment is here.
Victor's notes reference a Voice from Below.
A concealed sewer route exists.
hiddenFacts: The Voice is the Flooded Shrine's influence.

choices.label: Study Victor's notes
Examine Evelyn's body and the laboratory setup
Trace the concealed sewer escape
Hide and wait for Victor to return
Take the evidence to authorities

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: The lab can conclusively expose Victor. It does not automatically explain the Flooded Shrine's origin or wake Edric.

scenes.title: The Alchemist Breaks
requiredFacts: Victor's response depends on evidence and freedom of movement.
hiddenFacts: His strongest motive is Evelyn; his escape route can lead to the Sealed Crypt.

choices.label: Try to restrain Victor alive
Use Evelyn and his notes to try to break the Shrine's hold
Attack before he can flee
Let him run and follow
Press him about the Voice from Below

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Adjudicate restraint, persuasion and combat normally. If Victor has no plausible path to escape, do not teleport him into the sewers to preserve Edric's plot.

scenes.title: Wrong Turn Beneath Brannam
requiredFacts: Victor seeks the outflow/swamp escape; entering the Sealed Crypt is a panicked mistake, not his plan.
hiddenFacts: Edric sleeps in the Sealed Crypt.

choices.label: Push hard to catch Victor before he reaches deeper tunnels
Follow carefully and avoid sewer hazards
Try to reach the Ruined Outflow Passage ahead of him
Abandon the chase rather than risk the sewers

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use native chase/exploration rules. The source allows Victor to be stopped. Only route him into the crypt if the chase outcome plausibly produces the wrong turn.

scenes.title: Beneath the Streets
requiredFacts: Much of Brannam's sewer network is blocked, flooded or unstable.
hiddenFacts: The network can connect to Victor's hidden routes, the Sealed Crypt and much older King Below evidence.

choices.label: Follow signs of recent human use
Investigate strange older carvings
Push toward the old foundations beneath Edric's Ruins
Find the ruined outflow toward the swamp
Return to the surface

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use source encounter families and time costs. Do not make all sewer routes available from every entrance; respect discovered connections.

scenes.title: The Sleeping Tyrant
requiredFacts: Entering/breaching the Sealed Crypt wakes Edric.
Edric begins weakened.
hiddenFacts: Edric intends to relocate to Saint Arlen's Catacombs and feed.

choices.label: Attack Edric while he is weak
Grab the weapon/relic before he fully rises
Back away and prepare
Try to speak with Edric
If Victor is here, try to stop Edric killing him

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Edric prefers survival/escape if threatened while weak. If Victor is present and unprotected, Edric kills him. Do not force Edric's escape if PCs truly defeat him under native rules.

scenes.title: Kill the Vampire Before the Legend Returns
requiredFacts: Edric is vulnerable compared with his restored form but still a vampire under native source rules.

choices.label: Commit to destroying Edric
Retreat if the fight turns against you
Try to trap or reseal him rather than kill him

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve using native vampire mechanics and actual player resources. Source-specific destruction requirements must be respected by rules adapter.

scenes.title: The Tyrant in the Catacombs
requiredFacts: Edric relocates toward the Catacombs beneath Saint Arlen's Chapel.
hiddenFacts: Each successful feeding moves Edric toward restored state and produces a Herald of Return.

choices.label: Pursue him toward Saint Arlen's Chapel
Research Edric's old weaknesses and the Ruins first
Warn authorities and protect likely victims
Leave Brannam rather than fight him

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Time matters now. Meaningful delay can trigger feeding/restoration. Player defensive measures may alter victim selection but do not freeze the world.

scenes.title: Beneath Saint Arlen's Chapel
requiredFacts: The Catacombs have an interior Chapel stair and an exterior grate.
Upper levels contain prominent burials; deeper levels become older and stranger.
hiddenFacts: If awake, Edric uses the Catacombs as refuge.
Ancient lower passages connect thematically/physically toward the alien substrate.

choices.label: Track signs of Edric
Ignore the recent crypts and descend into the ancient levels
Study the old burials and inscriptions
Secure entrances to restrict movement
Return to the Chapel

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Respect multi-level geography and Edric state. Do not place Edric in Catacombs while still dormant in the Sealed Crypt.

scenes.title: Blood Beneath the Chapel
requiredFacts: Edric's current power depends on restoration/feed state and whether the Flooded Shrine remains intact.

choices.label: Confront Edric directly
Try to lure or trap him in a more favourable position
Avoid him and descend toward the deeper corruption
Retreat before he feeds again

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve Edric using current state, not a fixed boss stat. Destruction of Shrine may alter his advantages. Retreat remains valid.

scenes.title: Ruins of von Braech Keep
requiredFacts: The Ruins preserve traces of Edric's reign, religious conflict and hidden ways downward.
hiddenFacts: Historical/ritual evidence can connect Edric's transformation to the older Flooded Shrine.

choices.label: Study murals, records and surviving chambers
Search for hidden routes below the keep
Investigate the ruined Chapel and its chalice
Search beneath the ruins for the von Braech crypt
Return to Brannam

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use keyed Ruins content where extracted. Optional relic/altar interactions must remain optional. Hidden routes require actual searching.

scenes.title: Below Human Memory
requiredFacts: Architecture becomes older, rougher and increasingly alien/organic beneath later human construction.
hiddenFacts: The Flooded Shrine is the ancient causal source behind Edric and Victor.

choices.label: Follow the flooded route deeper
Study the chitinous/biological structures
Return before going farther
Return to the Ruins to find ritual records first

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Present alien influence as disturbing and partially incomprehensible. Do not explain its full cosmology because the source does not.

scenes.title: The Flooded Shrine
requiredFacts: The Shrine is an ancient alien biological device tied to the King Below.
It influenced Edric and Victor.
It can be destroyed or used through the Sacrificial Blood Rite if the rite is known.
hiddenFacts: Its full purpose remains unknowable.

choices.label: Destroy the Shrine
Risk studying/communing with it
Perform the Sacrificial Blood Rite
Withdraw and search for records explaining the old blood rite
Leave the Shrine intact

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Allow creative destruction plans and investigation, but preserve the two source-defined long-term resolution directions. Do not invent a consequence-free prosperity option.

scenes.title: The Murderer Is Dead. The City Is Not Saved.
requiredFacts: Stopping Victor and/or Edric does not automatically resolve the Flooded Shrine or Brannam's decay.

choices.label: Keep investigating what corrupted Edric and Victor
Search Edric's Ruins for the old blood rites
Accept solving the murders as enough and leave
Stay and help Brannam recover without touching the Shrine

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Let the party choose whether to pursue the deepest truth. Partial victory is valid.

scenes.title: The First Killer Is Stopped
requiredFacts: Victor no longer kills and Edric remains asleep.
hiddenFacts: The Flooded Shrine remains unless separately resolved.

choices.label: Follow the Voice from Below / older clues
Investigate Edric's history without opening the crypt
Leave Brannam after solving the murders

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Do not awaken Edric merely to force more content. If the players stop here, partial victory is canonically valid.

endings.title: Murders End, Brannam Endures
endings.summary: The immediate killings end, but Brannam remains a stagnant dying city under the unresolved influence/history beneath it. The party may return later.

endings.title: Cut the Root
endings.summary: The King Below's local influence ends and Edric is weakened if still active. Brannam is free of the Shrine but does not magically regain its lost prosperity; its people must live with the city that remains.

endings.title: Prosperity Has a Price
endings.summary: Brannam returns toward prominence while the annual sacrificial rite continues. The ritual leader becomes a beacon to the alien influence. The city is materially saved by embracing the horror beneath it.

endings.title: The Tyrant Returns
conditions: Edric awakened and left unresolved long enough to restore
endings.summary: Edric regains his former power, rebuilds his ruined keep and enslaves remaining residents for labour and blood, creating a larger regional threat and a future campaign state.

endings.title: A City Finally Dies
conditions: collapse reaches terminal state with core threats unresolved
endings.summary: Brannam's remaining civic order fails through panic, violence, flight and decay. Surviving threats persist according to their individual states.
